chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: It is not permissible for the one praying to pray with one prayer unless he has fulfilled the obligatory duty or the voluntary prayer.
So if he has prayed the obligatory duty or the voluntary prayer, his prayer is valid.

key_terms.الْفَرِيضَةَ: The obligatory duty (specifically referring to the five daily prayers)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the validity of a prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) emphasizing that the validity of subsequent prayers is contingent upon having previously established the habit of prayer through either an obligatory (*fard*) or voluntary (*nafl*) act, highlighting the importance of consistency in worship. This narration underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that maintaining the connection to prayer is essential for its spiritual acceptance and legal validity. It serves as a reminder that neglecting prayer entirely breaks the chain of devotion required for future prayers to be considered valid.
